rationale: Round 6 fixes two of R5's three round-5 precision asks cleanly: ADR Fitness now says ADR-0041 section 2 is unchanged and section 3 is amended, matching bead 6; and the failure-fixture label now correctly says thirteen for legs (i)-(xiii). The write-ahead discriminator is also restated in both the main protocol and the bead 6 ADR-0041 section 3 draft with the same three branches. Re-derivation, however, shows that its C-versus-D kind test is not total over supported complete flows. `mindspec complete <bead>` explicitly supports a clean worktree with no commit message, and the current commit primitives treat unchanged materialization or artifact stages as no-ops. If the proposed plumbing nevertheless builds the plan's stated C or D commit with a tree identical to its parent, both stages have the same empty parent diff: treating an empty diff as artifact-confined misclassifies C as D, while requiring a non-empty named-artifact diff misclassifies D as C. The plan does not instead pin no-op-stage elision or another durable stage identity. This is a localized, buildable correction, and the remaining ADR lens is sound: OQ-1(a) honestly reverses both load-bearing section-1 directions while retaining the panel-before-materialization trust boundary; ADR-0023's filesystem authority is confined to pre-epic drafts; ADR-0025's amendment is fenced to the worktree-creating next claim path; and leaving ADR-0037 untouched remains correct. But the ambiguous discriminator is the load-bearing recovery contract being added to ADR-0041 section 3, so it must be resolved at the plan gate rather than left to bead implementation interpretation.
concrete_changes_required: Make the write-ahead C/D stage discriminator total for supported no-op states, and carry the same rule into the bead 6 ADR-0041 section 3 draft. Either pin when empty C/D stages are elided and how recovery advances across them, or encode an unambiguous durable stage identity independent of whether the parent tree diff is empty. Add recovery fixtures for clean-tree/no-commit-message completion and unchanged-artifact sync so both C and D are classified correctly after interruption.

findings.summary: The requested three-way wording is present in both locations, but its C-versus-D structural sub-test is ambiguous when a stage has no tree delta.
findings.evidence: The main protocol at plan.md:235-249 and the bead 6 ADR draft at plan.md:898-907 both say tip==marker is complete, tip==marker-parent is unfinished, and other tips are foreign; both identify D by a marker-to-parent diff confined to the named artifact and otherwise identify C. Yet cmd/mindspec/complete.go:20 and :790-818 support completion without a commit message on a clean tree, while internal/gitutil/gitops.go:837-848 and :1675-1707 establish no-op-on-nothing-to-commit semantics. For an empty-tree C and an empty-tree D, the proposed parent-diff observation is identical, so no definition of 'confined' distinguishes both. The plan does not pin stage elision or another durable discriminator, despite calling the discriminator total over legitimate states.
